APIRef_tm_security_ip-intelligence_category
mgmt/tm/security/ip-intelligence/category
/tm/security/ip-intelligence
Specifies a shun entry addition to, and removal from, categories.

The IP,TTL entries to be added or removed. The format is <IP,TTL IP,TTL …>, with the TTL being optional. For example: <1.1.1.1,100 2.2.2.2 fe::fc,200, 2.2.2.2,infinite>.
tmName
string
required
read/write
The name of the category.
